invariants.rationale: Captures the two possible return paths: if scrollX is false, result is always 0; if scrollX is true, result is visualAmountX.
Describes the exact conditional assignment to result in terms of scrollX and visualAmountX.
If scrollX is false, must return 0, so either scrollX is true or result is 0.
If scrollX is false, result is 0; if true, all that is possible is result equals visualAmountX or 0.
Assuming visualAmountX is non-negative, result is always greater than or equal to 0.
